provenance.notes: Faithful native extraction from independently inspected original source figure. Ordinary labels remain live editable text; source photo details are separate raster assets. Diagnostic 3-d0 plot reconstructed natively from visually traced source geometry: native grid, trajectories, sample markers, ticks and segmented time color strip. Plot tracing and color gradient are approximate; no raster chart retained. Original raster assets isolated with their exact original alpha, clipping and affine transforms; no full-figure raster backdrop.
